description: Header file defining a template class BTreeScheduler for scheduling streams based on priority and sequence number, including methods for registration, scheduling, priority updates, and iteration.

classes.name: BTreeScheduler
classes.description: Template class implementing a priority-based stream scheduler with sequence ordering.

methods.name: HasScheduled
methods.description: Checks if any streams are currently scheduled.

methods.name: NumScheduled
methods.description: Returns the count of scheduled streams.

methods.name: NumScheduledInPriorityRange
methods.description: Counts scheduled streams within a specified priority range.

methods.name: ShouldYield
methods.description: Determines if a stream should yield based on higher priority streams.

methods.name: GetPriorityFor
methods.description: Retrieves the priority of a given stream ID.

methods.name: PopFront
methods.description: Removes and returns the highest priority stream.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new stream with a specified priority.

methods.name: UpdatePriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of a registered stream.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Adds a stream to the schedule if not already scheduled.

methods.name: IsScheduled
methods.description: Checks if a stream is currently scheduled.

methods.name: DescheduleStream
methods.description: Removes a stream from the schedule.

methods.name: StreamId
methods.description: Retrieves the stream ID from a schedule entry.
